fields.acceptance: A Go test runs install.sh against a local fixture channel (base URL override): it installs a working rhiza for the host platform, --channel latest picks the latest manifest, and a tampered archive fails with nothing installed; shellcheck install.sh passes
fields.statement: install.sh, run as curl -fsSL <raw URL> | sh, installs the newest release (or --channel latest) for the running linux or darwin on amd64 or arm64 into ~/.local/bin or --dir, verifying the archive sha256 against the channel manifest and failing on a mismatch

fields.acceptance: The README names install.sh, both manifest URLs and gh attestation verify; rhiza check passes
fields.statement: The README install section documents install.sh, the release and latest channels with their manifest URLs, go install, and how to verify a download with sha256 and gh attestation verify
